title: Bruno Vehicle Hire API Overview
description: spec-6-3: request-rate panel, populated by any traffic the API receives (Design Notes -- chosen over a rejected-request-count panel specifically because it renders real, non-zero data from the instant the API receives any traffic at all, including an evaluator just browsing the Angular UI).

panels.title: API request rate (per second)
panels.description: Count of structured request-completion log lines (UseSerilogRequestLogging(), method/path/status/elapsed only -- no request/response bodies) shipped to Loki, per second. Renders real data as soon as the API handles any HTTP request.
